Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. blocker (line 611): In the test "restores legacy single-page scenes, serializes all pages to JSON, and scopes visual exports via exportScene to the active page" (lines 611-638), spying on `clipboardModule.copyTextToSystemClipboard` does not intercept `exportToClipboard({ type: "json", ... })` because `exportToClipboard` calls `clipboardModule.copyToClipboard`, which in turn invokes `copyTextToSystemClipboard` via a direct intra-module reference inside `clipboard.ts`, causing `copyTextToSystemClipboard` to run unmocked in jsdom and fail with `Error copying to clipboard`. — fix: Spy on `vi.spyOn(clipboardModule, "copyToClipboard").mockResolvedValue()` instead of `copyTextToSystemClipboard`, and assert directly on the first argument passed to `copyToClipboard` (`expect(copySpy.mock.lastCall![0].map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["rect-p2"])`).

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
